Developer comments: Clicking the startup name opens its AREAS REQUIRING RESPONSE, built from real evaluation state: missing required founder details, deck slides the extraction found absent, and core evaluation areas the AI scored below the workspace threshold. Queries already sent are listed underneath.

Developer comments: Rebuilt as three panels: (1) startups with their overview details, AI score, flags and status, (2) the evaluation parameters (your additional parameters, then the core areas), (3) the clicked parameter's evaluation prompt, rubric anchors, weight and the AI's score and remark for the selected startup. Developer comments: New consolidated evaluation report: an AI column plus one column per evaluator who has scored the deck, each headed by their name and organizational title. The report widens automatically as the deck passes from associate to jury to programme manager. Opens from any score cell or the View scores column on every pipeline screen.

Description: The evaluators up the journey from Prog associate to jury to Prog manager, can view the scores given by the evaluators lower in the hierarchy but lower guys must not be able to view the evaluators' scores up in the hierarchy
Developer comments: Enforced on the server, not just hidden in the screen. Program Associate sees AI plus their own; Jury sees AI, Associate and their own; Program Manager sees AI, Associate, Jury and their own; Admin and Super User see all. A lower evaluator's browser never receives the higher scores at all - only a count of how many were withheld. Covered by automated tests at every level.

Assignment is no longer restricted to jury members.
